title: Omg HUGE package for my $$
text:
Omg HUGE package for my $$. The photo does not do justice to how packed this bag is, I can barely squish it. It's also 5.5cm deep. My hand is medium-sized and I am female. I hope that gives you some idea how much you will be getting.

Both the scent and flavor are potent. Super happy, will buy more again.. If I ever run out of this bag. lol
